summary: No vulnerabilities introduced. The trigger dispatch reuses (projectId, subscriberId) already authorized by the calling controller (requireOwned + project-scoped lookup) or the trusted engine path; FunnelEventService re-validates project scope via findById (anti-IDOR). matchKey flows into a parameterized Spring Data exact-match query (no string-built Mongo query). Depth threading preserves the manual=0 (volume-exempt) vs auto=depth>0 (rate-limited) classification — the three loop backstops remain solely in FunnelEventService and are not bypassable from the new call sites. No PII added to logs; no secrets; no new error-swallowing.
verified_owasp: A01 Broken Access Control / IDOR: no new surface — addTag/recordCustomFieldsSet operate on a caller-authorized project-scoped subscriber; dispatcher re-scopes by projectId (Optional.empty on mismatch)
A03 Injection: matchKey (slug/field-key/eventName) reaches Mongo via findAllByProjectIdAndTriggerTypeAndTriggerValueAndStatus (parameterized repository method), no concatenation

A04 Insecure Design / loop DoS: depth=0 from manual controllers keeps human roots exempt from the auto-enroll volume limit as designed; depth=enrollDepth+1 from steps counts auto children toward volume + depth-cap backstops; no backstop logic added or bypassed outside FunnelEventService
A09 Logging: no event payload / slug / field-key / eventName logged (Decision 16 PII preserved); no new log lines in the changed paths
